meta.title: De Ipoh - Discover Ipoh, Your Way
meta.description: Plan a personalized Ipoh journey around your interests, budget and travel style. Discover local experiences, stories and rewards.

hero.headline: Discover Ipoh, Your Way.
hero.sub: Hidden places, unforgettable food and local experiences curated around your interests, budget and travel style.
hero.secondaryHint: Discover the Ipoh you would not find on your own.

problem.heading: Do not just visit Ipoh. Experience your Ipoh.
problem.body: Choose your interests, budget and travel style. We will turn them into a personalized Ipoh journey.
problem.line2: The homepage is designed around Discover, Personalize, Explore and Earn.

howItWorks.heading: From Where Should We Go? to Your Perfect Ipoh Day.

steps.title: Tell Us About Your Trip
steps.body: Choose your duration, travellers and budget.

steps.title: Pick What You Love
steps.body: Select food, nature, culture, shopping or anything else you enjoy.

steps.title: Get Your Journey
steps.body: Receive a personalized itinerary curated around your interests.

steps.title: Explore And Earn
steps.body: Visit partner locations, scan QR codes and earn rewards.

rewards.heading: Explore Ipoh. Earn While You Are At It.
rewards.intro: Visit participating local businesses, scan QR codes and collect points as you explore.
rewards.earnBody: Collect points by completing experiences and visiting partner locations.
rewards.redeemBody: Use points for coffee, discounts, desserts, vouchers and local merchandise.
rewards.priceBody: Start with a personalized journey, then discover more as you travel.

guide.heading: Routes, not just a map
guide.body: De Ipoh is not a list of pins. It curates routes through food, nature, culture and local businesses.

features.title: Food trails
features.body: Kopitiam mornings, noodles, desserts and cafes.

features.title: Nature escapes
features.body: Caves, lakes, hills and limestone views.

features.title: Heritage walks
features.body: Old town streets, murals, temples and tin history.

businesses.heading: Bring De Ipoh travellers to your door
businesses.body: Join the experience network and help travellers discover what makes Ipoh special.
businesses.termsBody: Participating businesses can offer rewards, QR check-ins and locally relevant experiences.

items.a: A personalized travel discovery platform for Ipoh.

items.q: Can I plan around a budget?
items.a: Yes. The journey builder is designed around duration, traveller type, budget and interests.
Travellers visit participating businesses, scan QR codes and collect points.

partnerForm.heading: Partner enquiry
partnerForm.consentLabel: I agree to De Ipoh contacting me about becoming a partner, as described in the privacy notice.
partnerForm.successMessage: Enquiry sent. We will get back to you.
partnerForm.errorMessage: That did not go through. Check your details and try again.

footer.pdpaLine: We collect only what is needed to contact you about De Ipoh. See our privacy notice for details.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice covers the De Ipoh landing page forms and early partner enquiries.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: De Ipoh is a pre-launch travel discovery platform for Ipoh, Perak.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: We collect the details you submit through waitlist or partner forms.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: We use this information to contact you about the platform, launch updates or partnerships.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your information.
